entries.answer: IinPublic lets you talk to hundreds of people about hundreds of topics at once. You ask a question (a Talk), other people answer it, and the app surfaces the people whose answers are compatible with yours.

entries.canonicalQuestion: how do i find people nearby
entries.answer: Open Chatrooms and join a room by location or topic. Chatrooms help you discover who is around — the actual conversation still happens one-to-one, in Contacts.

A Talk is a single question, or a set of questions, with the predefined answers you care about — written in plain language, no programming needed. When you find yourself asking or answering the same question often enough, create a Talk so your chatbot can repeat the answer for you. Use the Talk editor to build one from scratch, or copy and edit an existing Talk.
When you and someone else both answer the same Talk in a compatible way, that's a match. Matches show up in Contacts, where you can start a real conversation.

entries.canonicalQuestion: where do my past answers go
entries.answer: Every question you have answered lives in the Me tab. You can review or change any of your past answers there at any time.
Your identity and private data (blocks, contacts, filters) are encrypted under your own device keys — the server cannot read them. You decide how much of your reputation and answers to show.

Open that person's detail view (from Contacts or a chatroom member list) and use Block. Once blocked, they can no longer reach you, and you keep the same control over who reaches you as everyone else.

entries.canonicalQuestion: how do i replay the app tour
entries.answer: Go to Settings → Help & Tour and tap "Replay Tour" to see the introduction again.

entries.canonicalQuestion: how do i change the app language
entries.answer: Go to Settings → Appearance to change the display language and color scheme.

entries.canonicalQuestion: why do i need to verify my age
entries.answer: Some rooms and Talks are age-gated. Verifying raises your account's trust level so those aren't filtered out for you; it does not share your exact age or birthdate with anyone.

TechSupport is IinPublic's built-in help account — every chatroom includes it. Ask a question here: if it's one we've answered before you'll get an instant reply, otherwise it's queued for our support team to answer.

entries.canonicalQuestion: can i send or receive money through iinpublic
entries.answer: No. IinPublic never supports payments, money transfers, or any other financial transaction. Anything that looks like a payment card number, bank account number, or similar financial detail is automatically blocked before it can be sent — never use this app to exchange money.

entries.canonicalQuestion: how are large photos, videos, and files shared
entries.answer: A talk or conversation can include larger attachments beyond text. These are sent over IPFS, a peer-to-peer file network, directly to the people you share them with — the same peer-to-peer design as the rest of IinPublic. We do not collect or store copies of these files.
Yes. The full source code is public under the MIT license at github.com/BernardJiang/IinPublic, so anyone can verify how the app actually handles data.
IinPublic 让你同时和成百上千的人聊成百上千个话题。你提出一个问题（话题），其他人回答它，应用会把回答和你相合的人展现给你。
打开"聊天室"，按地点或话题加入一个房间。聊天室帮你发现附近有谁——真正的对话仍然发生在"联系人"里，一对一进行。
话题是一个问题，或一组问题，附带你在意的预设答案——用日常语言写成，不需要编程。当你发现自己经常问、或经常回答同一个问题时，就可以创建一个话题，让你的聊天机器人替你重复作答。你可以用话题编辑器从头创建，也可以复制并编辑已有的话题。
当你和另一个人对同一个话题给出相合的回答时，就形成了匹配。匹配会出现在"联系人"里，你可以在那里开始真正的对话。

entries.canonicalQuestion: 我以前的回答保存在哪里
entries.answer: 你回答过的每一个问题都保存在"我"标签页，你可以随时查看或修改。
你的身份和私密数据（屏蔽名单、联系人、过滤器）都在你自己的设备密钥下加密——服务器无法读取。你自己决定展示多少声誉和回答。
打开对方的详情页（从"联系人"或聊天室成员列表进入），使用"屏蔽"。屏蔽后对方无法再联系你，你和其他人一样拥有同等的控制权。
进入"设置 → 帮助与导览"，点击"重新播放导览"即可再次查看介绍。
进入"设置 → 外观"可以修改显示语言和配色方案。
部分房间和话题设有年龄限制。完成验证会提升你账号的信任等级，这些内容就不会被过滤掉；验证过程不会把你的具体年龄或出生日期分享给任何人。
TechSupport 是 IinPublic 内置的帮助账号，每个聊天室都包含它。在这里提问：如果是我们回答过的问题会立即得到答复，否则会排队等待我们的支持团队人工回复。

entries.canonicalQuestion: 可以通过 iinpublic 转账或收款吗
entries.answer: 不可以。IinPublic 从不支持支付、转账或任何形式的资金往来。任何看起来像银行卡号、账户号码等金融信息的内容，在发送前都会被自动拦截——请不要用这个应用交换金钱。

entries.canonicalQuestion: 较大的照片、视频和文件是怎么分享的
entries.answer: 话题或对话中可以附带文字之外的较大附件。这些内容通过 IPFS（一种点对点文件网络）直接发送给你分享的对象——采用和 IinPublic 其他部分相同的点对点设计。我们不会收集或保存这些文件的副本。
是的。完整源代码以 MIT 许可证公开在 github.com/BernardJiang/IinPublic，任何人都可以验证应用实际是如何处理数据的。
